thread:
jinny_docs: Heads-up: Customer reported Console embeds not rendering — iframe element present but blank. Ticket #812. Suspect CSP/frame-ancestors or X-Frame-Options. Need tiny docs troubleshooting + snippets.

samira: I can add a Troubleshooting block to Console Embed guide: 3 bullet checks and two tiny snippets (vanilla + nginx header). Keep it terse.

brad_dev: If the iframe is present but blank, have them check the browser console for "Refused to display \"...\" in a frame because it set 'X-Frame-Options' to 'DENY'". Also check server side rules.

jinny_docs: Good call — include exact console error text to search for. Also add a one-line analytics note: iframe load impacts in-page analytics firing.

taylan: Add postMessage detection snippet for fallback (2s timeout). And an nginx example for frame-ancestors. Keep examples <= 5 lines.

support-bot: Suggested support checklist added: 1) Browser + version, 2) Console errors, 3) Response headers from the host page, 4) iframe src URL.

samira: Draft PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1212  7  — includes: troubleshooting block, vanilla JS postMessage fallback, React snippet reference, nginx header example, example console error strings, and the broken security link fix.

jinny_docs: Can someone review the wording? Need to avoid jargon and keep it prescriptive.

brad_dev: Quick nits: use "frame-ancestors" exact casing and show the nginx add_header line as one line. Also mention Safari iOS quirks.

samira: Updated PR with iOS note and tightened wording. Example inline JS:

```html
<iframe id="rw" src="https://embed.redwood.ai/app/ABC"></iframe>
<script>
  window.addEventListener('message', e => { if (e.data === 'rw:ready') console.log('embed ok'); });
  setTimeout(()=>document.getElementById('embed-help').style.display='block',2000);
</script>
```

And nginx: `add_header Content-Security-Policy "frame-ancestors 'self' https://app.example.com";`

taylan: LGTM. I'll approve.

support-bot: Lint OK. Linkcheck flagged /security/csp -> fixed in PR.

samira: Merged PR 1212. Deploy preview: https://deploy-preview-1212--docs.redwood.ai/console/embed#troubleshooting

jinny_docs: Verified preview. Setting a 48h support-watch on ticket #812. Thanks all.
